0022600100.text: Utah, 0-1 and 12th in the West, hosts the 0-1 New Orleans Pelicans, who sit 9th in the West, in the Jazz's second game of the 2026-27 season. Utah has yet to play at home this season, and Jusuf Nurkic is out with a foot injury, while Tony Bradley (quadriceps) and Trey Alexander (knee) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but New Orleans won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 156-137 win in New Orleans on April 7, 2026.
